overview.description: The T. Rowe Price Active Core U.S. Equity ETF (TACU) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on large cap equity. TACU is actively managed, seeking long-term capital growth by investing in US large-cap stocks TACU was launched on Dec 10, 2025 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.
